recipe.rationale: Use two complete native RER10bar-gauge<30kW supply-network services in the source market's literal50/50average/optimised shares. Both native services include compressor generation, operating materials, infrastructure delivery and distribution piping/losses; the earlier compressor-only candidate lacks that delivered-service boundary. No market freight or extra generation burden is added. Per signed declared m3 the caller factor is+1. Actual source and native references are+1m3;1000kPa gauge equals10bar gauge. Both inventory lineages cite Steiner/Frischknecht report23. Its chapter10tables use normalised-volume inputs and distinguish generation from consumer supply. This supports a common lineage-based volumetric screening basis, not proof of exact temperature/pressure-reference equivalence; those conditions are not individually stated in the installed metadata. No ideal-gas, pressure, density, Nm3 relabelling or energy-normalisation factor is invented. Preserve complete native inventories without repairing their internal loss model. Native average/optimised networks draw1.5/1.05units of generation per output; the inspected source producers have different operational and compressor coefficients, including their distribution model. Generation, loss, piping-material supply, delivery, electricity sourcing, compressor service-life, internal uncertainty and vintage therefore differ. This is a functional screening proxy, not a source-inventory reconstruction or an LCIA-equivalence claim. The average native service retains its literal xx-prefixed name in the original archive and both exact release catalogs. The original XML describes an ordinary product dataset with network/leakage scope and a+1m3reference; it provides no explicit meaning for that prefix. Do not remove the prefix or claim it certifies dataset quality. Its unexplained marking and native model quality remain an explicit screening limitation. Preserve caller signed quantities, formulas, supported uncertainty, separate flows and foreground ownership. Source internal uncertainty is replaced by native supplier uncertainty; no caller quantity renormalisation, added recovery credit, or silent omission is introduced. Native biosphere exclusions remain visible. Score effects are unquantified. Only exact inspected ecoinvent3.9cutoff is qualified; other releases, reverse and cross-system-model requests cannot inherit this review.

primary_report.title: Life Cycle Inventories of Metal Processing and Compressed Air Supply
primary_report.basis: Chapter10: Tables10.3–10.5 and10.10–10.12 use Nm3 in operating/material calculations; Tables10.14–10.15 declare m3generation outputs and link the same per-volume coefficients. Original source/native documentation independently identifies the same lineage. Exact reference temperature and pressure are not established by the installed metadata.
primary_report.retrieval_status: Author report reproduced by a third-party host; no reliance on the host's AI summary. Report lineage and coefficients cross-checked against source and original native inventory metadata.

rejected_alternatives: Compressor-only proxy: loses the source delivered-air distribution scope.
Invented pressure/density/temperature or electrical-energy scaling: source physical coefficients must not be guessed.
Silently correcting native1.5/1.05generation draws: alters a complete native service without a separately established correction.
One optimised service for both branches: unnecessarily discards the available average/optimised source split.
